entries.description: Bundle size budget check (idea-078): added check-bundle-size.js guard rail to build pipeline
changes: Added scripts/check-bundle-size.js — reads scene-bundle.js size, compares against configurable thresholds (warn 750KB, fail 900KB)
Integrated into npm run build between scene bundle and astro build steps
Thresholds configurable via BUNDLE_WARN_KB and BUNDLE_FAIL_KB environment variables
Build aborts before Astro step if bundle exceeds fail threshold
Added tests/unit/check-bundle-size.test.js with 14 unit tests (all pass)
Current bundle: 681.0KB — passes with margin under 750KB warn threshold
